subject.title: feat(agents): canonical agent creation with Custodian hatch flow

question: Should OpenClaw make conversational Custodian-mediated agent creation a supported Control UI workflow while extending the public gateway contract with optional workspace and agent handoff fields?
rationale: The patch is not only a refactor: it introduces a new user-facing creation path and durable public protocol behavior that needs maintainer product ownership beyond mechanical correctness.

options.title: Sponsor the Custodian creation flow
options.body: Accept the new Control UI workflow after real-flow and upgrade proof confirms the protocol and existing CLI/RPC behavior remain coherent.

options.title: Keep creation CLI/RPC-only
options.body: Retain the internal canonicalization work but remove or defer the new Custodian and Control UI entry points until a separate product decision.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Custodian creation flow
recommendation.body: Accept the new Control UI workflow after real-flow and upgrade proof confirms the protocol and existing CLI/RPC behavior remain coherent.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commits show direct responsibility for the proposed shared creation and hatch-flow design.
